room_rent.note: Room, boarding & nursing not exceeding 1% of SI per day; proportionate deduction if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU not exceeding 2% of SI per day

copayment.note: No flat co-pay; 20% co-pay ONLY if insured opts lower zone and is treated in a higher zone (Clause 5.29)

sub_limits.note: Cataract 10% of SI / ₹50k per eye; modern treatments capped; mental illness 25%; ARMD 10%/₹75k; genetic 25%; ambulance 1%

specific_disease_waiting.note: Tiered 90 days / 24 mo / 36 mo lists; listed-disease bulk at 24 months

maternity.note: No maternity benefit clause; only a definition appears

cumulative_bonus.note: +25% SI per claim-free year, max 50%; reduced at same rate on claim

restoration.note: VERIFY - no SI restoration/reinstatement clause found

day_care.note: Day care treatment defined and covered

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excl. organ cost) within SI

ambulance.note: Road ambulance not exceeding 1% of SI per insured event; numeric SI-relative, not a fixed ₹

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments each capped (e.g. Deep Brain stimulation up to 50% SI/₹5L; oral chemo 10%)

consumables.note: VERIFY - no consumables/non-medical cover found; standard non-medical exclusions apply

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation excluded; dietary supplements; standard IRDAI Excl01-18

optional_riders.display: Revision in Cataract limit (SI ₹8L+), zone-based cover options
